name: Maintainability evidence
description: Harness-owned semantics for complexity, duplication, dead-code and naming evidence without universal taste thresholds.

rules.title: Use project-selected thresholds for maintainability gates
rules.summary: Function size, complexity, nesting, duplication and similar thresholds should come from an accepted project/profile contract rather than an arbitrary global default.

rules.title: Keep historical debt visible under quality ratchets
rules.summary: A baseline may prevent new regressions but must not transform historical findings into a clean quality result.
